title: Run Run Run
desc: An unemployed computer engineer finds himself indebted to a ruthless money lender. However, things take a turn when he is robbed on his way to pay off his debts.

title: Seetharamam
desc: Afreen, a Pakistani woman, heads to India in order to deliver a love letter written in 1965 to fulfill her grandfather's dying wish. However, the journey alters her life forever.

title: Anbarivu
desc: Twins, Anbu and Arivu, are separated at birth. Later, when their paths cross, the siblings are forced to switch families, as they strive to reunite their loved ones.

desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

title: Kullanari Koottam
desc: Vetri, an unemployed young man, meets Priya and falls in love with her, but faces challenges when her father wants him to join the police force.

title: Theeran Adhigaaram Ondru
desc: Theeran, a dedicated police officer, pays the price for his honesty and faces hardships when he tries to investigate the illegal activities conducted by a powerful gangster.

title: Vattam
desc: A heartbroken man decides to solve his agony, but things take a turn for the worse when he gets entangled between kidnappers and a distressed couple.

title: Mothi Vilayadu
desc: Business tycoon Rajan Vasudev's rival hires an assassin to kill his only heir, Udhay. However, the killer accidentally murders Udhay's companion Madhan instead.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Tamizh Padam 2
desc: Shiva, a former cop, vows never to return to the force, but when his wife is brutally murdered by the notorious don P, he swears vengeance.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: Aranmanai 4
desc: Suspicious about his sister's death, Saravanan, a lawyer, tries to solve the mystery behind it, only to discover a mysteriously dark force at play.

title: Oh Baby
desc: A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Kaala
desc: Haridev Abhayankar, a corrupt minister, wishes to seize Dharavi's lucrative land for his own gain. However, Karikaalan, the locality's godfather, fights to protect his people's rights and assets.
